_comment: Distinct from callsign_vectors.json, which pins the structural VALIDATION rule the
transmit gate applies. This file pins the encoding: what integer a callsign occupies in
the 28-bit field, and whether it survives a round trip.
A priori decoding asserts those 28 bits as certain, so the packer must put an accepted call
exactly here. 'round_trips' decides whether a callsign may be used at all: a call that took
the retired packers' generic Base-37 fallback packs to an integer that does not unpack back
to it. v1 (crates/z30-protocol) refuses every such call instead of transmitting it.
Generated from the retired TypeScript codec and asserted by it and by the retired Python
oracle until both were removed (2026-10-06 cleanup, last present at acfce5e). Kept because it
was produced independently of the Rust code; it cannot be regenerated and must not be edited.

vectors.why: lower case is upper-cased before packing
portable prefix: takes the Base-37 fallback, does NOT round-trip
portable suffix: takes the Base-37 fallback, does NOT round-trip
the placeholder Station Settings holds before a callsign is entered
